column1: # Files worms plant in a project and run from a hook or a task when the folder is opened.
# One line each, tab separated. After editing, run: bash tools/gen.sh
#   folder    .claude or .vscode
#   file      the file's name
#   incident  an id from data/incidents.tsv
#   note      shown under the file when it is found. A settings file that runs any of these
#             files is shown with "runs" before the note (or a general line, if the notes differ)
#   alone     yes: only a worm uses this name, so the file counts wherever it is found. no: projects
#             use the name too, so the file counts only in a project that holds a yes file, or when
#             its SHA-256 is one in sha256; anywhere else section 2 lists it as a file to read
#   sha256    the SHA-256 values the sources publish for this file, separated by commas, or -

# fd3ca400 (the loader in .claude and .vscode, identical in both) and 54dc7ea5 (the loader in the
# npm packages). A hook counts when it runs any of these file names from either folder.
